output.title: Spacious 4-Bedroom Villa with Garden and Double Garage
output.description:
This detached villa, constructed in the 1970s, offers approximately 200 m² of living space within a well-maintained residential setting. The stone façade complements the traditional architectural style, and the property includes private grounds featuring a front lawn and a sizable garden.

Inside, the living room retains original features such as wood paneling and a stone fireplace, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere with views over the garden area. The accommodation comprises four bedrooms and two bathrooms, suitable for varied domestic arrangements.

Outdoor amenities include a mature private garden with a large lawn, mature trees, and a patio area, presenting an opportunity for outdoor activities and relaxation. Additional functional features include a terrace, cellar storage, and parking facilities with a double garage.

The property’s design and setting reflect its established residential character, offering a balanced combination of indoor and outdoor living spaces.

highlights.text: Original stone fireplace in living room
